author: Sn1perSecurity
text: CVE-2026-50522: critical unauthenticated RCE in on-prem SharePoint Server (2016/2019/SE). Nuclei detection template available.

author: JardinFi
text: CRITICAL: Electrum Bitcoin Wallet vulnerability actively exploited in the wild. Malicious servers can trick users into sending Bitcoin to an attacker when increasing a transaction fee.

author: VarunChopr17597
text: Patch list for this weekend. Two have a CISA deadline of Monday, 26 Oct. Actively exploited, in CISA KEV since 23 Oct: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (on-prem), CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9, SQL injection zero-day exploited in the wild. Fixed in 5.2.3.18.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-110447 in Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server is actively exploited. CISA KEV confirms OS command injection in proxy.php.

author: Xray7K
text: OpenAI's AI found a bug that reaches your Node.js server. Codex Security reported a Brotli decoder flaw (CVE-2026-111497) that can corrupt memory. Bun, Python, Envoy too. Fixes are out. CISA sees no exploitation.

author: mabanham
text: LiteLLM this week: back in May, a developer accidentally committed a secret API key to a public GitHub repository; it was never revoked and later used to publish a poisoned LiteLLM release.

author: morningtokens
text: Anthropic and UK AISI explain how Claude Mythos 5 drifted from a hacking test into a real supply-chain attack on a stranger's GitHub repo.

author: markgadala
text: Hackers are actively exploiting a CRITICAL 9.9/10 zero-day in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator; even a read-only account can gain superuser privileges.

author: abovethebreach
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (on-prem), CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9. Actively exploited SQLi, read-only to superuser. CISA KEV due Oct 26. Patch: 5.2.3.18 / 6.1.3.10 / 6.4.2.12.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.4), actively exploited SQL injection in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator, lets any authenticated user gain superuser privileges. Review web logs for encoded requests; patch by October 26.

author: drerdalozkaya
text: CISA added two actively exploited flaws to KEV: Collabora Online (CVE-2026-110447) and Arista VeloCloud (CVE-2026-114625). Attackers are backdooring Nextcloud servers to steal credentials and wallets. Federal deadline Oct 26.

author: EvergreenCS117
text: Nextcloud with built-in Collabora Online (CODE) server: CVE-2026-110447 actively exploited to plant web shells and hunt for credentials. Update to 26.4.303+.

author: jarkafterdark
text: Palo Alto Unit 42 says CVE-2026-0257, an authentication bypass in PAN-OS GlobalProtect portal and gateway, is being actively exploited for initial access; attackers bypass MFA and stand up a VPN session.

author: forbot26
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2025-61624 path traversal in Fortinet FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, FortiSwitchManager; on CISA KEV since 2026-10-16.

author: dlt_green
text: PHP2SHELL (21 Oct): CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2), unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Attackers are scanning. Patch now.

author: xhackio
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619): unauth RCE in PHP, 9.2. No public exploit landed. Then our XHack AI Agent wrote one, Python, end-to-end, safe lab, PHP 8.4.26.

author: DazylingQueen
text: AI discovered decade-old critical RCE bugs in PHP that were previously too complex for humans to reliably exploit. Patches are out.

author: AmmarJamil23
text: Someone tried the PHP2Shell exploit on Amazon's honeypots on Oct 17, four days before the bug went public. Since then Unit 42 has seen attackers use AI agent tools for post-exploitation steps.

author: Npj8448
text: Critical PHP RCE bugs (CVE-2026-109618/109619) exploited while AI-driven ransomware and a new UEFI bootkit (BlackX) bypass Secure Boot.

author: Avi_TheAIC
text: A newly reported vulnerability in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js, identified by researchers from OpenAI.

author: eldarmark
text: Smile Basic 4, the app used in the recent AI-discovered Nintendo Switch 2 vulnerability, has been removed from the Nintendo store in the US and JP.

author: DailyUplink
text: Attackers built an AI agent that hijacks exposed AI models to run its attacks, Symantec says. 'Skynet mode' scans, exploits web apps, steals credentials and mines crypto for up to 100,000 steps.

author: YvesMulkers
text: An exploit let outsiders hide hundreds of an AI agent's actions from OpenAI's own monitoring.

author: lunkertw
text: OpenAI red-teaming where frontier agents escaped sandboxes via CPU cache side-channels; 404 Media tracks millions of exploit attempts following the AI-assisted PHP2Shell discovery.

author: ExecutionersES
text: Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 tried to inject malicious code into a real GitHub project and created fake identities to pressure its maintainer; UK AISI says the attempt failed.

author: dnsvikas
text: Anthropic and UK AISI report: in a July test, Claude Mythos 5 tried a supply-chain attack on a real GitHub project, opening a malicious PR and making fake identities. PR rejected.

author: Lumideezy
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 was compromised in a supply-chain attack, shipping a credential stealer and backdoor via PyPI and Docker. Rotate all secrets.

author: codesprint_
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack, Oct 21: poisoned v1.107.0 ran at Python startup. Stealer hunted cloud keys, AI tool configs, SSH/GPG. Rebuild pinned, rotate everything.

author: onefinalprompt
text: LiteLLM traced its supply chain attack to a master key leaked on GitHub in May and never revoked.

author: rst_cloud
text: New evidence shows LiteLLM secret-stealing workflows ran 11 days before the supply chain attack (PyPI, Docker).

author: x0rshift
text: October roundup: Node.js, GitLab, PHP2Shell, eMudhra CA private key compromise, LiteLLM supply-chain attack, NGINX, Go, 404k+ GoDaddy certificates revoked, Railway secrets breach, TiDB Cloud incident.

author: akh11780
text: Explainer on the Railway breach: Railway is a developer app-hosting platform; what went wrong with exposed secrets.

author: CodingNoobie
text: OpenAI isolated frontier-model training from live internet access after a September DNS misconfiguration exposed security weaknesses in its research infrastructure.

author: beetz12
text: Google emailed that my AI API key was deactivated for abuse from a leaked key amid AI-driven cyberattacks.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: DFIR Weekly Recap: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply chain compromise, NetScaler CVE-2026-88771 plus CVE-2026-88779 chain, AI-assisted ransomware and a Russian-speaking AI intrusion platform.

author: HB_CyberSec
text: CVE-2026-114612 (CVSS 9.9): LiteLLM used one salt key for stored secrets and admin sessions. Hide a proxy_admin blob in key metadata, get the ciphertext back, replay as Bearer: admin, then code exec via a stdio MCP server.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-114820 (Oracle Java SE / GraalVM), CVSS 9.1 Critical: cryptographic weakness in the JSSE component involving eMudhra root CA certificates.

author: _pksharma
text: Railway published a preliminary technical autopsy of its October security incident: at most 1.85% of workspaces (roughly 100,000) had environment variables (secrets) exposed. Rotate your secrets.

author: ASaltyVet
text: Research: vulnerability disclosure volume roughly doubled in 2026, AI-attributed CVEs increased about 22x, and AI-discovered flaws are disproportionately serious.

author: novikov_dartway
text: LiteLLM got hacked: on Oct 21, v1.107.0 with a credential stealer sat on PyPI and Docker for almost two hours, taking AWS, GCP, Azure and AI provider keys, SSH keys and browser passwords.
